tools.name: get_agent_manifest
tools.description: Start here (free): 5 tools, prices, daily per-tool/per-token trial status and intent-based journeys. Choose liquidation radar, native BTC/ETH depth, Li.Fi swap or the L2 archive catalog. Compact includes arguments; detail=full adds quota/pass/onboarding.

tools.name: swap_via_nattswap
tools.description: Cross-chain token swap powered by Li.Fi across 70+ chains incl. Hyperliquid. USE WHEN: bridge, fund gas, treasury routing, or rebalance. RETURNS: Li.Fi route + execution_readiness + swap_actions_v1. Prefer signing swap_actions_v1 in order. MCP free; on-chain swap costs gas + HyperNatt 0.25% integrat

tools.name: get_l2_archive_catalog
tools.description: Free, read-only. USE WHEN an agent needs historical raw Hyperliquid L2 order-book data for BTC or ETH: returns the catalog of the sealed archive (coverage, files, SHA-256, free 24h sample under CC BY 4.0, offers, x402 purchase endpoints, terms). Same JSON as https://hypernatt.com/api/datasets/catalo

tools.name: get_native_depth
tools.description: BTC/ETH perpetual market context: four simultaneous recorded liquidity views (REF, M2, M5, AGG4), size coverage, fixed-price wall changes and observed aggressor buy/sell flow over 30s or 300s. Aggregated views see wider price ranges at coarser precision; never add their overlapping volumes. Combine

tools.name: get_liq_radar
tools.description: Returns the liquidation map of one coin (BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP, HYPE or ZEC; default BTC). If cluster_grammar is present, read it first: class=noise (distance <3%) is high-leverage bait to ignore; class=true (~7%+) is the low-leverage stack. The liq_radar block (hypernatt_liq_radar_v2) holds model

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_agent_manifest" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
